# Official scoring code, PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019

`evaluate_sepsis_score.py` is the challenge organizers' own scoring script, copied unchanged on 11/14/2026 from https://github.com/physionetchallenges/evaluation-2019 (BSD 2-Clause license, see `LICENSE.txt`).

We did not write it and did not edit it. `src/utility.py` calls its `compute_prediction_utility` function so that the utility score in this project is the organizers' definition, not ours.
